# Cargo Global

Global product sourcing, supplier shortlists, quality checks and door-to-door delivery for buyers across the US, Canada and Mexico.

## Primary pages
- [Sourcing](https://flashcargoglobal.com/sourcing/)
- [Start a Request](https://flashcargoglobal.com/contact/)
- [Supplier-country checklists](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/)
- [About](https://flashcargoglobal.com/about/)
- [Terms](https://flashcargoglobal.com/terms/)
- [Privacy](https://flashcargoglobal.com/privacy-policy/)

## Scope
Serving buyers across the US, Canada and Mexico. Supplier options, quality checks, currency, inclusions, exclusions and delivery requirements are confirmed before purchase.

## Request status
Current requests are saved for review. Automatic form-to-email delivery is not enabled.

Last checked: 2026-10-23
